question: Qual é o último ZIP?
answer:
Pelo campo **Created** dos ZIPs numerados no catálogo oficial, o mais recente é o **[ZIP 259: Deployment of the NU7 Network Upgrade](https://github.com/zcash/zips/blob/afa086bd976e316612a5c06fb139429958d07d84/zips/zip-0259.md)**, criado em **2026-09-15**, com status **Draft**. Catálogo verificado em 28 de set. de 2026, 00:50 UTC.

Essa é a data de criação declarada no documento, não uma confirmação da primeira publicação. Alguns ZIPs não informam essa data; o maior número também não indica o mais recente. O status do documento não comprova ativação na rede.

question: Check official sources now: what is the latest published Zcash ZIP as of today? Give its title, status, source URL and verification date; do not assume the highest number is the newest publication.
answer:
The newest numbered ZIP by its **Created** date in the official catalog is [ZIP 259: Deployment of the NU7 Network Upgrade](https://zips.z.cash/zip-0259), status **Draft**. That catalog was retrieved on 28 September 2026 at 00:50 UTC from revision `afa086bd976e` of the [zcash/zips](https://github.com/zcash/zips/blob/afa086bd976e316612a5c06fb139429958d07d84/zips/zip-0259.md) repository. Its Created date is 15 September 2026; that is the author’s creation date, not a verified first-publication time, and Draft does not mean network activation.

The highest number is not the newest: [ZIP 2007](https://zips.z.cash/zip-2007) is Reserved and was created on 5 July 2025. Twenty-seven numbered documents have no Created date, so an undated file could still be newer than ZIP 259.

question: Explain ZIP 32 hardened key derivation in plain English, in two sentences with a source.
answer: ZIP 32 hardened key derivation makes a new child key only from the parent secret key and chain code, and only when the child index is in the hardened range (2³¹ or higher). If the index is not hardened, derivation fails, which is why Orchard wallets in this spec support hardened derivation only. [ZIP 32](https://zips.z.cash/zip-0032)

sources.title: ZIP 416: Spending Key Derivation in the `zcashd` wallet

question: And how does that differ from non-hardened derivation?
answer: Non-hardened derivation uses a child index below 2³¹. For Sapling, ZIP 32 supports it from an extended full viewing key, so later addresses can be derived without the parent spending key. Hardened derivation uses an index of 2³¹ or higher and requires parent spending-key material, so a viewing key alone cannot produce those children. Orchard in this specification allows only hardened derivation. [ZIP 32](https://zips.z.cash/zip-0032)
